static int handle_any (  Ecore_Ipc_Server **  server,
call *  cp,
char *  line
)  [static]
 

process a command (entered in shell, parsed in evsh_parse_line()).

at this point, the command is known, but its parameters still have to be parsed. the function will do this, then send the request to evidence.

Returns:
an error-code
Parameters:
server connection to evidence
cp the command to send
line the input-buffer containing the parameters for the command
